fields.detail: Primary route: directive 2, the mechanical-word / geometrically weighted floor sum — v(x) = sum_j digit_j * 10^(k-1-j) with digit_j(x)=floor(x+(j+1)a)-floor(x+ja), telescoping to v(x)=floor(x+ka)-10^(k-1)floor(x)+9*sum_{j=1}^{k-1} 10^(k-1-j) floor(x+ja); Psi(k) is the second moment over the k+1 arc-midpoint representatives with rational slope a=F(n-1)/F(n), F(n)>>k. Re-test it only at k=F_n-1 (the F_n rotations of q_n truncated to k letters, A(d)=max(0,m-t)+max(0,m-(N-t))), and it should pass exactly there. For general k the correct replacement is the arc version of directive 3 (C(j,j+d) = number of the k+1 reps in A_j ∩ A_(j+d), arc length depends on d alone, still a lattice-point count, still collapses) — but NOTE the primary route does not need Phase 3 at all; this remains a checkpoint, not the method. refs: directive 1 + directive 3; status stays open as a checkpoint.

Exact integer/rational arithmetic. Per directive 3, Phase 3 (the C=A collapse) is NOT part of the primary route and must not be fixed or built on. The load-bearing identity is Phase 2: the telescoped v(x) of directive 2 (v(x)=floor(x+ka)-10^(k-1)floor(x)+9*sum_{j=1}^{k-1}10^(k-1-j)floor(x+ja)), which already passes against brute for k=1..150. Remaining work: the universal Euclidean algorithm (monoid generalisation of AtCoder floor_sum / Chtholly) carrying (count, sum x^j, sum x^j*floor, sum x^j*floor^2) mod M=101001001, x=10^-1 mod M, evaluating the second moment. Acceptance test: it must reproduce the Phase 4 anchors Psi(10^4)=16242174 and Psi(10^6)=77578256 mod M before the final run. Per directive 4: build the universal-Euclidean O(log) monoid NOW — this is the only thing between the run and the answer; Toeplitz defects and extension-recurrence residues are off the critical path. Spec: walk the lattice path of y=(p*t+q)/r for t=1..n (one R step per unit of t, one U step per unit increase of floor(y)), split by the Euclidean recursion as in AtCoder floor_sum, O(log) merges. Node carries dR, dU, w=z^dR, S0=sum z^t over R steps, S1=sum z^t*floor(y), S2=sum z^t*floor(y)^2, all relative to segment origin, mod M=101001001; compose l with r: dR=l.dR+r.dR; dU=l.dU+r.dU; w=l.w*r.w; S0=l.S0+l.w*r.S0; S1=l.S1+l.w*(r.S1+l.dU*r.S0); S2=l.S2+l.w*(r.S2+2*l.dU*r.S1+l.dU^2*r.S0); identity zeros with w=1. The dU shifts carry floor values across a boundary — the one place this goes wrong; test hard. Acceptance in order, none skipped: (1) S0 vs direct loop, random p,q,r,n,z; (2) S1 vs plain floor_sum at z=1 and direct loop at z!=1; (3) S2 vs direct loop; (4) telescoped v of directive 2 through the primitive vs code/mech/mech_psi.py k=1..150 and vs Psi(10)=10699667; (5) matcher for the VALID general-k values (direct method, O(k^2)) at k=1000 and k=10000 — the old Phase-4 anchors are refuted (claim phase4-anchors-invalid: both were Psi_collapse at k outside F_n-1) and are NOT the gate. Only after (5) passes run k=10^18 with Fibonacci approximant F(n)>10^18 and confirm stability across TWO different approximants. If the outer sum over the k+1 reps resists one pass: the x_m are themselves the orbit frac(-m*a), so m is another floor-sum index — carry the joint state in the same monoid instead of looping over m.

fields.detail: Directive 9 (this cycle) replaces the joint-monoid reduction of psi-to-ueuclid-reduction.md (which fought the O(k)-intercept obstruction) with the contiguous-window prefix-sum route. THE FIRST STEP, before building anything: check the three asserted claims against code/mech/mech_psi.py, exactly as the directive demands. Claim 1: the k+1 DISTINCT length-k factors = the k+1 CONTIGUOUS windows at positions r=F_n-k-1 .. F_n-1 of the doubled standard word q_n q_n, as sets equal (sample at k=3 with q_4 q_4=0100101001: windows 010,100,001,010,101, the last four are the distinct factors, 1+100+10000+10201=20302). Claim 2: Psi(k) = (full cyclic sum over all F_n windows) - (sum over the FIRST F_n-k-1 windows). Claim 3: the full cyclic sum = sum_{j,jp} A(jp-j) 10^(2k-2-j-jp), A the cyclic autocorrelation of q_n, for ANY k < F_n (rehabilitates directive 1's autocorrelation form for general k; the identity was never restricted to k=F_n-1 as a statement about the CYCLIC sum — only about the cyclic sum equalling Psi, which claim 2 corrects). These are ASSERTED, not established; file the check results before building. After claims pass: the one object is the partial sum of v_r^2 over the prefix window range, via v_(r+1)=10 v_r - y_r 10^k + y_(r+k) (y the Fibonacci word), state (v, sum v^2, sum v, 1) as a constant-size transfer matrix whose step depends on the pair (y_r, y_(r+k)), product collapsed by Fibonacci-block renormalisation (~87 blocks at 10^18). The universal-Euclidean primitive still serves Claim 3's full-cyclic lag-sum (sum_d (ad mod N) x^d) — coordinate with build-universal-euclidean-primitive. Acceptance: Psi vs mech_psi k=1..150, Psi(10)=10699667, then anchors 34432237/20938836, then k=10^18 with stability across two approximants.

fields.detail: Psi(k) = sum_{m=0}^k v_m^2, v_m = sum_{l=0}^k c_l floor((l-m)a) with c_0=-10^(k-1), c_k=1, c_l=9*10^(k-1-l). Since floor((l-m)a) = floor((-p m + l p)/q), all terms share slope A=-p/q and differ only in intercept; Psi = sum_{l,l'} c_l c_{l'} C(l,l') with C(l,l') = sum_m floor((Am+B_l)/q) floor((Am+B_{l'})/q), a lag-autocorrelation of the single-intercept floor sequence. Need O(log) evaluation of this double sum (avoids the O(k) distinct-intercept obstruction). tool_builder (run-18) verifies the reduction expansion == mech_psi at k=1..150 and reproduces anchors 10699667/34432237/20938836 by O(k); symbolic_math (run-19) derives the closed form.
